tools/organize/name-groups.alt: Organize listing an unsorted folder, with common-name chips and one-click smart selection by file type.

features/files/grid.alt: The Files page showing a library as a grid of video thumbnails with codec, size and bitrate under each.

features/cleanup/duration-filter.alt: Adding a duration filter on the Cleanup page narrows thirteen files down to the short ones.

getting-started/concepts/jobs.alt: The Jobs page listing finished jobs with their status, and a Logs toggle on each.

getting-started/hardware/transcoder-tab.alt: Settings, Transcoder tab: the detected GPU is named in the concurrent-transcodes hint, with a slider for files per GPU.

getting-started/first-scan/add-library.alt: The Add Library dialog: a path field with a folder-browse button, a split-into-sub-libraries option and a scan-after-creation option.

getting-started/first-scan/folder-picker.alt: The folder picker listing the folders mounted into the container under /media.

features/libraries/overview.alt: The Libraries page with one library card showing its folder, file count and when it was last scanned, plus refresh and delete buttons.

features/files/list.alt: The Files page in list view, with filename, codec, duration, bitrate, dates and size in columns.

features/duplicates/results.alt: The Duplicates page: a row of criteria chips, a count of duplicate groups found, and the first group with its copies side by side.

features/compress/select.alt: The Compress page with the output settings bar, a quick-select card for files that are not HEVC, and the file grid with the estimated saving on each card.

features/compress/settings.alt: The encoding settings drawer: video format, encoding speed, quality slider, maximum resolution, and the estimated size and saving.

features/toolbox/fixes.alt: The Toolbox page with two fixes added, Trim and Normalize volume, shown as chips above the file grid.

features/splice/merge.alt: The merge drawer listing three videos in order, a notice that they can be joined without re-encoding, an output name and a one-chapter-per-file switch.

features/originals/list.alt: The Originals page: a summary of backups and space that can be recovered, and a backed-up file with its original and current size and restore and delete buttons.

features/files/audio.alt: The Audio Files page: a list of tracks with their format, duration, bitrate and size.

features/duplicates/images.alt: Image duplicates: a similarity slider, a Find Duplicates button, and groups of look-alike pictures.

features/duplicates/audio.alt: Audio duplicates: criteria chips for duration and audio fingerprint, and a group of matching tracks with one marked to keep.

features/compress/audio.alt: Audio compression settings: output format, a bitrate slider with a quality label, and the estimated size and saving.

features/files/images.alt: The Images page showing a library as a grid of photo thumbnails, with filters and search along the top.

features/originals/quarantined.alt: The Quarantined page listing images set aside, each with restore and permanent-delete buttons.

features/image-upscale/options.alt: The Upscale options: quality tiers Fast, Sharp and Natural, a resize method, and a switch to use the processor only.

features/content-review/label-filter.alt: Content Review with a detection-label filter: matching images appear in a grid with their detection labels, thumbnails blurred.
